Package com.itmeansbigmountain.osrsapi

Raw JSON helper clients for OSRS-related public APIs.

This package is intentionally small and dependency-free. It is suitable for RuneLite plugins or standalone Java 11+ utilities that want quick access to Wise Old Man and TempleOSRS endpoints without committing to a specific JSON parser. The helpers return response bodies as String values.
